$comment: Recorded hourly-limit shape: 403 WITH x-ratelimit-remaining: 0. That is the ONLY 403 the resolver labels the hourly limit; the reset is taken from x-ratelimit-reset.

headers.access-control-expose-headers: ETag, Link, Location, Retry-After, X-GitHub-OTP, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Used, X-RateLimit-Resource, X-RateLimit-Reset, X-OAuth-Scopes, X-Accepted-OAuth-Scopes, X-Poll-Interval, X-GitHub-Media-Type, X-GitHub-SSO, X-GitHub-Request-Id
